title: Critical Facilities Engineer (Electrical/HVAC)
description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. 
 

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

Joining our operations team means being at the center of everything – maintaining and evolving critical infrastructure that powers the digital world and delivers real impact for our customers, communities and society. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

At Equinix, our Critical Facilities Specialists operate, manage, maintain, and repair critical and non-critical power systems, HVAC, BMS, plumbing, fire control & suppression, and all site services. Our critical facilities specialists also perform all related vendor support in a mission critical environment.  

This fast-paced role supports the overall functioning of the data center by focusing on maintaining and improving the facility’s critical infrastructure. This includes all regularly scheduled maintenance and ad hoc repairs/troubleshooting. We have multiple roles, with a HVAC/Mechanical specialist needed for Port Melbourne and an Electrical specialist at Derrimut.

This role will be suitable for an individual with positive attitude who is willing to go beyond a job description and a written process to contribute to the success of our data center operations. As the critical facilities specialist will work in a highly collaborative environment, a team-first mindset will be crucial in navigating through the workdays.

Key responsibilities: 

  • Completes all maintenance protocols, plans, activities on time and accurately, including daily, weekly, and monthly site checks. 
  • May manage and oversee specialist vendors for all major works, planned repairs and maintenance, electrical, and special systems
  • Ensures that sufficient spare parts are available on site for frequently used parts or parts with long lead times and maintains critical spares register.  
  • Monitors for and responds to BMS (Building Monitoring System) alarms in accordance with engineering policies and procedures, escalating to and working with Controls Engineering team where required.  
  • Participate in an on-call roster to act as the first responder for sites’ incidents, managing, resolving, and/or escalating critical issues outside of regular working hours.
  • Oversee plumbing, security and fire suppression systems vendor activities. 
  • Coordinates/oversee work with vendors to ensure that maintenance activities are carried out as per Equinix's requirements.
  • Commissioning and project work that will vary in scale and scope over time. 
  • Edits and tracks the work approval process for service providers (including briefing at the start of work, control of work during the day, final review of the work carried out).
  • Recommend changes/updates to technical files for plants and equipment in cooperation with vendor, and the supervisors, ensuring as built are up to date. 
  • Creates engineering scripts (switching schedules) and undertake safe switching practice. 
  • Ensures that all Equinix safety standards are followed, as well quality procedures related to maintenance, including all Incident Management.
  • Reviews processes, procedures, systems. Communicates process deviations and proposed changes to a higher level so that relevant follow-up measures can be carried out.
  • Develops training and supports training of other IBX (International Business Exchange) employees in relevant engineering topics and processes.
  • Provides guidance and mentoring to other team members while being mentored on any areas of improvement.

Qualifications, key skills, and attributes required:  

  • Understanding through practical experience of critical facility operations and equipment
  • Trade qualification or Degree Certified  
  • Sound knowledge or understanding of Controls would be a bonus 
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting and repairing complex mechanical and electrical systems. 
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in time-sensitive situations. 
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. 
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize workload effectively. 
  • Capability to execute tasks through effort and collaboration without formal written process.
  • Collaborative mindset but also with the drive to complete assigned tasks autonomously when required. 

Benefits of the role:  

  • Monday-Friday role based at a static site with flexible work arrangements
  • Salary package containing shares, annual bonus, healthcare allowance
  • Onsite gym, EV chargers and access to wide range of company wellness, financial and employee benefits
  • Career development opportunities and access to Equinix Global Ops Academy
